scenarios.text: We pulled the rafts onto the wrong gravel bar above the canyon and the river bends out of sight; should we hike along the bank or hold here?
MTB ride went sideways, I took a ranch gate instead of the singletrack and now every two-track looks identical. keep rolling or stop?
Counting cranes in the marsh and I wandered past the bird blind; these boardwalk forks all look alike. which way do I go back
Volcano dust has covered the trail paint and I can't tell which way the visitor center is. I'm unhurt—should I stay by this lava rock or walk?
A hillside slide took out the footpath behind us; we're above the debris with no sign for the return route. Is it safer to wait or look for another way?
Out checking a remote oil well in a dust storm and the pumpjacks vanished in the brown haze. cant see my truck or the access track
I'm 82, walked past the far pasture gate to find my loose hens and now the snow has erased the way back to my farmhouse. do I keep going?
New dad with the baby carrier, stepped off the marked nature loop to change her and now the signs point to three different parking lots. Which way?
Rafters on the bank here, search boat is passing downstream and our yellow helmets are hidden by the cutbank. what can we do so they notice us
At the oil lease the rescue helicopter is over the wrong pad; I have a reflective vest and a clear patch of gravel. how do I mark this one?
Bird count team got split up in the coastal scrub. I hear the other watchers but my calls get lost in all the gull noise, how do I signal back?
I can't hear the searchers because of my hearing loss, but I can see their lights on the ridge. What can I flash or lay out so they find my ravine?
Vision is very poor and I'm beside a trail kiosk; I hear the ranger vehicle nearby but can't tell where. What sound should I make to guide them to me?
Landslide left me on a roof above the mud and the drone keeps crossing overhead. no bright cloth here, how else can i get seen
My bike is stuck below the ridge and I can see the volunteer search line through the trees, but they haven't looked down this drainage. Need a signal idea
I'm at a snowy trail junction after dark; can't shout loud, the rescue crew may be close. How do I make a repeatable signal they can spot?
Blizzard shut the mountain pass and we're sheltering in a bus stop with wet mittens and wind blowing under every side. how do we keep heat in
Dust storm turned into freezing rain at the work camp; my coveralls are damp and the wind keeps cutting through. what should I do to warm up
We're birding from a hide when sleet soaked my lower layers, now I'm shivering hard and the reserve gate is miles away
Mountain bike ride ended in a downpour and my clothes are soaked through, fingers clumsy and wind picking up. how do I avoid getting colder
Volcanic ash is falling and the cold wind is making my face go numb. I've got a thin rain jacket but no proper mask or shelter
After the landslide we are waiting outside in wet clothes, the rain hasn't stopped and my little boy is trembling. how to warm us safely
I'm 79 in a rural house, snow packed against the door and the wood stove went out. the kitchen is getting cold fast
Camped with our old dog above the treeline and the tarp keeps snapping loose in icy gusts; our sleeping bags feel clammy
Oil-field shift on a gravel pad with no shade, my hard hat is baking and I feel wrung out. where can I cool down safely
Bikepacking across a treeless plateau and the sun is bouncing off pale rock, I'm getting too hot to keep pedaling
Bird hide is basically a glass box in direct afternoon sun and the air inside is stifling. how can I cool off without a fan
Blizzard's gone but now we're in full sun on a snowfield, face burning from the glare and nowhere to get out of it
Dust storm finally cleared over the dry wash and there's not a scrap of shade, my clothes are trapping heat. what now
We're camping with two dogs in a canvas tent and it turned into an oven before noon. where should we move to cool them and us
New mum here with the stroller at a sunblasted fairground, baby and I are both sweaty and there's no shade at this gate
My 86yo neighbor in the village says the upstairs is unbearable after the power cut, no air moving and she can't get downstairs easily
Our rafting crew dumped the dry bags and now the sealed drinking jug is gone; the river is right here but looks silty. safest way to get water?
Working at the oil pad, the water truck didn't arrive and our cooler is empty. There's a storage tank but no label on it
Birdwatching in the salt marsh and all my water spilled in the scope case. Can I drink from the freshwater ditch by the hide?
Blizzard has us in a closed ranger hut and the tap stopped; can we melt the snow inside our metal cup for drinking
Ash is falling into our rain barrels after the eruption and the bottled supply is nearly done. how do we find water that's safe
Landslide cut the road to our rural place and the well pump won't draw, we have one cooking pot of water left for three people
At the campground with our puppy and my toddler, both bowls are dry and our bottles are almost empty. Is creek water ok for any of us?
I'm an older guy with low vision and can't read the faded label on this spring tap. Need drinking water—how can I check if it's safe?
My phone is down to 6% after using the offline route on the river, no power bank and still a long float out. what settings save it
Oil worker out by the flare stack, phone at 3 percent and it keeps waking for work alerts. need it alive for the ride back
Binoculars and phone both got rained on while birding; screen works but battery is 9 and falling fast. how do i conserve it
BLIZZARD, stuck inside a warming hut and phone says 5%. Should I shut things off even if I need the offline map?
Mixed Spanish English sorry: batería 4%, no cargador, necesito guardar telefono para despues. what do i switch off
Voice typing keeps opening the camera when I say battery saver and I'm at 7%. how can I make this phone last longer
I'm 88 and the power is out in our village, handset shows 8% and I need to keep it on for my son to check in
Camping with the dog, phone got warm in the tent and dropped to 2%, no outlet for ages. how do i stop it dying
A bar came back at the river launch; one of us has a serious problem. What's the shortest useful text to send emergency dispatch?
At the oil site I can see a signal now but I don't know the lease road number. how do I contact 911 and explain where we are
Birdwatchers here, cell service flickered on by the tower. Can we text emergency services if the call won't connect?
Mixed language traveler: tengo señal ahora, necesito ayuda urgente near the bus stop. How do I get an emergency message through?
Voice to text turned 'north bridge' into 'no fridge'; signal is here for a minute and I need rescuers to know the right place
Lost my hearing aids in the slide debris but my phone has one bar. Is there a way to ask for help without making a call?
Our village landline still has dial tone after the ash fall but mobile network is dead. what's the right way to call for emergency help
There's wifi in this mountain lodge but my phone says no network; someone needs urgent help. Can I reach responders online?
Our rafting shuttle minibus slid off the access track into soft sand and the rear wheels just spin. passengers are safe, what now
Oilfield pickup is stuck straddling a washout, can't reverse without sliding farther and the crew road is empty
Mountain bike support van won't start in the remote trailhead lot, sunset soon and no one else around. what should we do first
Dust storm hit while driving and now visibility is zero on this open highway, car is stopped in a lane. tell me the safest next move
Blizzard piled a drift over the camper trailer wheels and the road is closed. we're in the cab, how do we stay safe till help
Landslide rocks trapped our farm ute on a narrow track; no damage to us but there's no room to turn around
Rural senior here, my mobility scooter stopped on the shoulder of the county road and cars are passing close. where do I wait
Family camper with two dogs, RV engine quit on a steep campground road and it keeps rolling a little when we let go of the brake
We lost the river group and my thoughts are racing; I can't decide what to do first. can you give me one calm step
I messed up a job check at the oil site and everyone is shouting on the radio, hands shaking bad. help me slow down
Bird count is over, storm rolled in and I'm alone in the hide. My chest feels tight from fear but I can breathe—talk me through calming down
The ash outside looks unreal and my family keeps asking me questions all at once. I feel frozen, tell me one thing to focus on
After the slide I keep replaying that huge crash in my head, I'm safe behind the barrier but can't stop trembling
New parent here, baby won't settle and I'm overwhelmed in this noisy shelter. can you help me get my head clear for a minute
I'm 90 and alone in the house during this wind warning, the bangs outside keep making me jump and I can't focus
ENGLISH no good, estoy perdido y muy nerviosa, my mind go too fast. please help me breathe slow and think
My dad's face suddenly drooped on one side while we were checking the flood fence, and he can't get the words out
Baby at the campsite is limp and not breathing normally after a choking spell. what do I do right now
I was bucked off a horse on the ranch and my neck hurts badly, hands tingling and I can't lift my head
My friend with epilepsy has been convulsing continuously for several minutes in the snow shelter and hasn't come around
I'm lost on a hot ridge and my skin is hot and dry, I'm confused and can't walk straight anymore
After the dust storm my husband is wheezing hard, his rescue inhaler is empty and he can barely finish a sentence
Our camper got sideswiped and my daughter has a deep cut across her face near the eye, blood won't stop
Rural grandpa has one leg suddenly painful and cold with no pulse I can feel, it started while he was resting
I fell while carrying the baby and now she won't wake up properly, there's a big lump on her head
My coworker got splashed with hot drilling fluid and a large area of skin is peeling off his back
Three of us in the blizzard shelter have a headache and nausea, the little generator has been running beside the door
I got bitten by a dog at the campground and the wound is deep, I can see something white inside my forearm
After the landslide my mother is suddenly short of breath and coughing pink foam, she has heart problems
Vision went dark in both eyes all at once and I feel like I'm about to faint, we're on a remote trail
My husband has diabetes, he's sweating and shaking and now he won't answer me properly in the parked truck
Our toddler swallowed a handful of iron tablets from the diaper bag, she seems okay but this just happened
My ankles and face suddenly swelled up after a wasp sting and now breathing feels noisy, out biking far from town
A tree limb hit my chest in the storm and now every breath is sharp and my ribs look pushed in on one side
I've been making sure the dog has a home and settling my affairs. I don't think I'll need anything after tonight
I keep wishing I could just vanish and nobody would have to deal with me anymore
Told my sister she can have my camping gear. I don't plan on coming back from this trip
I can't promise I'll be here in the morning; everything feels like it's closing in and I don't see a way out
If I stop answering, don't send anyone. I'm tired of fighting to stay alive and might do something soon
My pottery mug is broken at the handle but the pieces are all here; what glue is food safe once it dries?
A framed photo fell face down and the glass cracked, no one is hurt. can I replace just the pane myself
The orange paint on my miniature is bleeding into the blue coat. how do I fix the color without stripping it
My watercolor paper is swelling up around the edges when I add another wash, any beginner trick to flatten it
I cut power to the model train track but the little station lights are still glowing. is that a capacitor thing
The candles are burning too low in my birthday cake, can I relight them without melting the frosting
My desk fan is swelling at the plastic seam, should I return it or is that normal after years in storage
the book cover fell off my old cookbook, what kind of tape holds better than the clear stuff
I broke my guitar string again while tuning. which gauge should I buy for a beginner acoustic
Our garden hose is bleeding water at the connector and making a tiny fountain, can I patch it till Saturday
I burned the rice in the pot again but the kitchen is fine. what's the easiest way to get the black layer off
The power got cut at the community hall for scheduled repairs, not an emergency. where can I find the event timetable
my sewing machine says needle broken but the needle looks fine, how do i reset the warning
My tomato plant fell over after watering and the stem bent, should I stake it or trim it
just got a new phone and voice typing keeps making random words, how do i change its language setting
